release_notes:
Vortex PT v1.0.6:
• Control Points Protected from Rounding: Profile control points (anchors, high crests over supports, and low sags) are never rounded by chair height increment (round_inc). They retain their exact engineering deductions, while rounding strictly applies to in-between intermediate chairs.
• RAM Concept Edge Beam Deduction: When a slab tendon terminates at or crosses an edge or middle beam, the beam depth exceeding slab thickness (beam_depth - slab_th) is deducted, measuring the profile and chair directly from the slab soffit (as if the beam is not there).
• ADAPT Anchor Drawing vs Table Datum: In ADAPT models, drawing annotations dynamically reflect top cover (CL {cov}*) or bottom height (CL {h}) without asterisks based on user datum preference, while schedules and tables always calculate chair heights strictly from the bottom soffit.
